analysis_result.analysis: The model fundamentally misunderstood the cube color configuration. It assumed each cube is monochromatic based on one visible face, contradicting the explicit ground truth that each cube has six distinct colors. This led to hallucinating a 'red cube' with six red faces, and erroneously concluding that five of them are hidden. In reality, only one red face exists across all cubes (on Cube 1’s RIGHT side), and it is visible — so zero red faces are hidden. The error cascades from perception to grounding to reasoning, making it a critical failure in interpreting structured visual data.
